title: Eighth Chapter: Merits and Method of Visiting Kazimayn

blocks.x: EIGHTH CHAPTER: MERITS AND METHOD OF VISITING KAZIMAYN
MERITS AND METHOD OF VISITING KAZIMAYN

In addition to the merits and method of visiting the holy shrine of Imam Musa al-Kazim and his grandson Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (al-Taqi), this chapter includes some references to Masjid Buratha, the method of visiting the Four Emissaries (of Imam al-Mahdi), may Allah be pleased with them, and the method of visiting Salman.( ) This chapter consists of several sections, as follows:
